title: 3D electron diffraction reveals piracetam Form VI two decades after its computational prediction.
authors: Nowak, Maurycy E; Modrzejewski, Marcin; Lanza, Arianna; Svard, Michael; Malinska, Maura; Madsen, Anders O; Krzeszczakowska, Joanna; Syty, Krystyna; Pham, Khanh Ngoc; Hoser, Anna A
one_liner_zh: 该文通过3D电子衍射实验验证了吡拉西坦的预测晶体结构，虽涉及机器学习势能计算，但核心对象为小分子晶体而非蛋白质结构，与蛋白质结构计算课题关系较弱。
abstract: Crystal structure prediction often yields low-energy structures that lack experimental structural confirmation. Using 3D electron diffraction, we resolve predicted piracetam Form VI from a nanocrystalline powder mixture. Free-energy calculations place Form VI among ambient-accessible polymorphs and highlight machine-learning interatomic potentials as scalable tools for finite-temperature polymorph ranking.
abstract_zh: 晶体结构预测常产生缺乏实验结构确认的低能结构。利用三维电子衍射，我们从纳米晶粉末混合物中解析出预测的吡拉西坦Form VI。自由能计算将Form VI置于环境可及的多晶型物之列，并凸显机器学习原子间势作为有限温度多晶型排序的可扩展工具。
